_readme: Standing instructions about the OWNER TEXT CHANNEL. Read by scripts/owner_attention.py:standing_rule_blocks() on every send, so an instruction takes effect without a deploy. classes.<reason> = {"allow": false, "why": "..."} silences one class of owner-bound text. permissions.<name> = {"approval_required": false, ...} records that a class of message is ALREADY authorised and must not be brought back for a per-message yes. This file is NOT the same thing as owner_text_suppression in authority.db, which matches a substring of (reason + body) and held exactly one inert row on 2026-10-15 because the topic written from a complaint was a whole English sentence.

owner_attention_item.why: ONE item at a time, question or notification, no counts and no file path. The owners instruction of 2026-10-14T14:18:21Z (sms_log 4176): "I already told you these random briefs seem pointless. I need one item at a time, either a question or notification, not some random text that says 36 items, 30 urgent". Set "allow": false here to silence this class entirely without a code change.

owner_attention_digest.why: RETIRED 2026-10-15. The old pager digest body (count + 4 truncated fragments + "full: data/owner-attention/latest.txt"). It reached him 24h AFTER he banned it, at 2026-10-15T14:13:28Z, and he had named it a useless text twice. Nothing may emit it again.

cfo_to_owner_or_wife.why: OWNER, 2026-10-18, verbatim: "The cfo doesn't need my permission to send things like that to me or my wife." A routine finance or household question the CFO needs answered -- an unrecognised charge, a subscription nobody remembers, a membership with unused credits -- is ALREADY authorised to the owner and to his wife. Do not ask him whether it may be sent; do not bring the body back for a per-message yes. 'Things like that' means a question about the household's or the business's money that only they can answer.
does_not_cover: anything that commits money, a price, a date or a legal posture -- those are his, per the outbound-comms hard stop
a message to anybody other than the owner or his wife
a message whose body he has not seen that was composed by a session that then changed the facts
cfo_to_owner_or_wife.where_enforced: owner_text_relay.ceiling_for + the SEPARATE_CHANNELS exemption (ceiling and rate floor) for family_chat, live since 2026-10-18 d4ffe3aad4d0; the approval half is enforced by the absence of an approval gate on this path -- see ledger 526/527
